histogram.normalization: in-bin mass: common_norm=True pooled, False per-curve

histogram.cumulative: count/mass sums; density integrates mass; no frequency; multiple=fill is cumulative composition, not CDF

histogram.geometry: grouped stack/dodge keep heights; dodge splits raw bin width including reserved empty hues

kde2d.weights: canonical paired relative mass; physical Kish before ties
kde2d.covariance: unbiased full covariance; gaussian or variance-one Cholesky epanechnikov_product, explicitly nonradial
kde2d.normalization: selected full cohort, including skipped singular fields; effective-hue/global pool, not each size/style tuple
kde2d.support: cut/clip choose evaluation/view only, never trim or rebase fit
kde2d.conditional_default: absent HDRSpec retains finite-grid trapezoidal mass ranking with all tied heights; conditional, not full-space coverage
kde2d.cumulative: true original-law joint lower-orthant CDF; no finite-grid subtraction/renormalization or Jacobian; common_norm amplitude remains an explicit contribution

kde2d.axes: actual Cartesian2D primary/y2, v/h, declared input clocks
kde2d.style: real native contours/cells, physical outline points/dashes

full_hdr.statement: support/numeric/source-transform/classification/native/clip allocations remain separate; bounded conditional target and region symmetric-difference error under declared IEEE/computed-model assumptions, not an exact infinite-source law
full_hdr.visibility: actual clipped probability is reported, not called p
full_hdr.failure: unresolved order/precision/tolerance/resource rejects the whole effect; no level dropping/conditional fallback

kde2d.limits: no 2D stack/fill ordinate, CDF+mass-HDR or arbitrary callbacks
kde2d.precision: canonical source/mass before float; full-exponent scaled and outward primitives; unresolved derived coordinates stay errors

ecdf.definition: right-continuous mass of X<=t; complement is X>t
ecdf.weights: finite nonnegative; count sums weights, not number of rows
ecdf.normalization: within each selected curve, not across hues
ecdf.rows: drop required missing and zero-weight rows before positivity
ecdf.ties: aggregate equal values into one full jump
ecdf.empty: no curve/legend; explicit hue order reserves color/style
ecdf.support: finite numeric; full jump at min; no tail extension
ecdf.axes: Cartesian2D v/h; observations use actual x or target y/y2 clock; positive observation log and linear non-calendar mass axis
ecdf.precision: canonical dyadic source/mass before ties; percent unit combined before final float, strict complement from exact right mass
ecdf.semantics: shared raw hue/size/style tuples; size=stroke points
ecdf.markers: filled named markers at actual right-continuous knots only; never the prepended boundary sentinel; explicit marker_size points
ecdf.unknown: reject ignored options; no fit/intervals/censoring; explicit paired empirical fields use ecdf2d, not an inferred univariate option
